# Pre-Implementation Requirements Checklist: Cloud Architecture Studio AI — MVP

**Purpose**: Author-facing "unit tests for the requirements" across the four MVP risk areas —
chat/AI generation, security & connections, UX & accessibility, and pricing accuracy — walked
before `/speckit-implement` to catch requirement defects while they are cheap to fix.
**Created**: 2026-07-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Chat & AI Generation (FR-014a–d, FR-015, FR-016a)

- [x] CHK001 Is tool-attachment scope defined precisely — does an attached provider persist for the rest of the conversation, or must it be re-attached on every message? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014a]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the "assistant asks to attach" behavior specified for the case where earlier messages had tools attached but the current one does not? [Coverage, Spec §FR-014a, Gap]
- [x] CHK003 Are requirements defined for what "updates the existing architecture in place" must preserve — manual node positions, prior direct edits, configuration overrides — versus what generation may overwrite? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014d, Gap]
- [ ] CHK004 Can "the assistant's context reflects the edited architecture" be objectively verified as written (what observable behavior proves the sync happened)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-016a]
- [ ] CHK005 Are partial-result requirements consistent between the unsatisfiable-request edge case (error + partial) and the per-provider MCP failure edge case (success + partial)? [Consistency, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK006 Are requirements defined for a second chat message sent while a generation is still in flight (queued, rejected, or cancels the first)? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the 30-second target's scope defined for iterative follow-up messages as well as initial generation, and is "typical request" characterized? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK008 Are conversation-thread lifecycle requirements defined for project duplicate (is the thread copied?), delete, and sharing (can a shared read-only user see or post to the chat)? [Coverage, Gap]

## Security & Connections (FR-004, FR-006–013, FR-025)

- [x] CHK009 Are verification-gate requirements complete for accounts that never self-register — the seeded super admin and admin-created users (exempt, pre-verified, or must verify)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, Gap]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "scoped read access" for the Atlas connection quantified with the specific permission scope(s) required? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the app's own session-duration and expiry requirements specified (the spec defines AWS session expiry but not the platform sign-in session)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK012 Are token-hygiene requirements complete for verification and reset links — expiry durations, single-use enforcement, resend rate — or are the durations unstated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003/FR-004, Gap]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the effect of "suspend" specified — immediate session revocation versus refusal at next sign-in — and what a suspended user sees? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Gap]
- [ ] CHK014 Are requirements defined for how shared (read-access) users interact with connection-dependent features — whose provider connection powers recommendations/pricing in a shared project? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK015 Are the "no long-term credentials" rule (FR-012) and the storing of encrypted temporary session material at rest stated so they cannot be read as conflicting? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012]

## UX & Accessibility (FR-016, FR-026)

- [ ] CHK016 Are generation-progress requirements specific beyond "sees progress" — what is displayed, and whether a user can cancel an in-flight generation? [Clarity, Spec §US2/AC6, Gap]
- [ ] CHK017 Are empty/zero states defined for every list surface — projects list, connections page, and a chat thread with no messages? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, Gap]
- [ ] CHK018 Are layout requirements defined for the chat panel + canvas side-by-side arrangement on mobile widths (stacked, tabbed, hidden)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-026, Gap]
- [ ] CHK019 Is undo/redo scope clear about whether chat-driven architecture changes participate in the canvas undo stack alongside direct edits? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, Gap]
- [ ] CHK020 Are keyboard-only interaction requirements defined for canvas operations (selecting, connecting, moving nodes), or is pointer input implicitly assumed? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK021 Does the version-conflict requirement ("reload and re-apply") state whether the user's unsaved local changes are preserved through the reload? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Pricing Accuracy (FR-019–021, SC-002)

- [ ] CHK022 Is the boundary between "exact" and "indicative" cost defined with objective criteria (what precisely qualifies a figure as exact)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK023 Are currency and pricing-region assumptions specified — whose region's prices are shown, and is multi-region pricing in or out of scope? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 Is the ±5% accuracy target's measurement method defined — sample configurations, the authoritative comparison source, and how often it is re-checked? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK025 Is "update cost estimates immediately" quantified with a latency threshold and reconciled with the server round-trip required for official pricing? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK026 Are cost requirements defined for usage-based services whose monthly price depends on assumptions the user has not provided (requests, storage growth, data transfer)? [Coverage, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK027 Is each hard external dependency (official MCPs, email delivery, LLM availability) paired with an explicit degraded-mode requirement rather than only a general fallback statement? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK028 Are the Assumptions that carry product behavior (single shared workspace, no rate limits, sharing scope) cross-referenced from the FRs they modify, so an implementer reading only the FRs cannot miss them? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items that surface a real defect should flow back into the spec via `/speckit-clarify` or a direct edit before `/speckit-implement`
